mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_VERIFICATION ( VERIFICATION_NO, MEMBER_NO, VERIFICATION_FILE, ORIGINAL_NAME, RENAMED_NAME, STATUS, SUBMITTED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_MEMBER_VERIFY_NO.NEXTVAL, #{memberNo}, #{verificationFile}, #{originalName}, #{renamedName}, 'W', SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT V.VERIFICATION_NO, V.MEMBER_NO, V.VERIFICATION_FILE, V.ORIGINAL_NAME, V.RENAMED_NAME, V.STATUS, V.ADMIN_COMMENT, TO_CHAR(V.SUBMITTED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS SUBMITTED_AT, TO_CHAR(V.PROCESSED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS PROCESSED_AT, V.PROCESSED_BY FROM MEMBER_VERIFICATION V WHERE V.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY V.SUBMITTED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_VERIFICATION WHERE 1=1
AND STATUS = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET VERIFIED_REVIEWER = #{verifiedReviewer}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}
